sources.fact: The official native Google tag snippet uses an async script and function gtag(){dataLayer.push(arguments)}. The prepared browser queue retains genuine Arguments objects.
Consent defaults precede commands that send measurement data, including config and event.
Automatically collected events include first_visit, session_start and user_engagement; command capture alone does not certify SDK/property/report scope.

activationGuard: mountDocumentAnalytics defaults loadScript to null; the production component passes no loader. Thus even an enabled production/public DTO cannot activate the unverified SDK.
inspectionSeam: A controlled GoogleScriptLoader receives a prepared async/no-referrer HTMLScriptElement only after denied defaults, sanitized settings, config and first valid event are queued. Unit/React tests capture it without executing or requesting Google code.
remainingEvidence: fully intercepted real SDK/browser wire and storage, including hidden/derived/autonomous behavior and referrer headers
property/server-derived event and report behavior unavailable from wire alone
actual full application/browser route composition and JavaScript cost
